reason: The visible temporal evidence does not directly establish a directional shift from foundational physiological and biological studies toward applied areas.

suggested_revision.target_text: We interpret this pattern as suggesting a thematic evolution from foundational physiological and biological studies towards more applied areas.
suggested_revision.replacement_text: The visible evidence documents year-by-year counts for frequent keywords and an overlay spanning average publication years of about 2014.64 to 2017.37, but it does not by itself establish a directional thematic evolution from foundational to applied research [E020, E067].
